title: Sun Park Evidence & Position-Shift Atlas
intro: Eight linked lenses, one physical hotel: follow the documented right, the valuation premise, the statement, the judicial act and the later economic claim without presuming causation.
boundary: An attributed statement is not a certified property title. A court order establishes only what it decides; a funding or subsidy announcement is not proof of payment, unlawful proceeds, professional liability or recoverable loss.

labels.stages: Nine Band 2 markers, with documentary limits
labels.valuations: Different purposes—not a single price scale
labels.finance: Which financial step has actually been proved?
labels.notTitle: The 2021 figures are not a current Land Registry certificate.
labels.noCausation: Chronology does not by itself prove causation, knowledge, title or individual wrongdoing.

stages.title: Historic control and Lava Verde presentation
stages.assertion: Marketing/project descriptions concerned the former Sun Park site.
stages.limit: Publicity alone does not prove whole-property ownership or authority to operate.
stages.missing: Dated source captures, title and operating agreements.

stages.title: Investor-facing hotel project
stages.assertion: The historical project material described approximately 220 apartments and a proposed €12m conversion.
stages.limit: A project described as under study does not establish subscriptions, funding or complete legal title.
stages.missing: Original distribution list, signed commitments and investment decision file.

stages.title: RICPE's fragmented-title qualification
stages.assertion: The reported split was 54 CAM / 190 LPB / 18 third-party fincas, with uncompleted project conditions.
stages.limit: The certification records information supplied to RICPE; it is not a current official register of all 262 titles.
stages.missing: Complete property folios and original diligence/LOI sequence.

stages.title: HNT / MYND Yaiza operating transition
stages.assertion: The subsequent CAM-to-HNT economic-unit segregation and MYND hotel operation require separate title and contract analysis.
stages.limit: A corporate notice does not establish transfer of every third-party finca or right.
stages.missing: Notarial segregation annex, Registry, licence and management contracts.

stages.title: RICPE financing marker
stages.assertion: Band 2 attributes €6,573,703.10 of funding to the HNT / MYND Yaiza project.
stages.limit: An attributed financing amount is not independently authenticated drawdown or net benefit.
stages.missing: Signed loan instrument, bank entries, collateral and use of funds.

stages.title: Regional incentives marker
stages.assertion: The recorded regional award is €3,440,914.20 against €11,469,714 investment and 60 proposed jobs.
stages.limit: An award is not by itself proof of subsidy payment, compliance, breach or fraud.
stages.missing: Payment ledger, certified eligible costs and employment reports.

stages.title: Platform operating scale
stages.assertion: The company described more than €100m in hotel sales; a distinct source used €48m operating revenue.
stages.limit: Neither figure is demonstrated as MYND Yaiza-only turnover, cash received, or a claimant's loss.
stages.missing: Entity-specific audited accounts and hotel operating statements.

stages.title: RICPE portfolio funding scale
stages.assertion: Band 2 displays €45.27m as a hotel-loan subtotal and €51.66m as the larger eight-project total.
stages.limit: Overlapping portfolio categories cannot be added together or traced to Sun Park without records.
stages.missing: Project-by-project loan register and actual money movements.

stages.title: Hospitality-platform footprint
stages.assertion: The wider platform described 12 hotels and approximately 2,500 rooms.
stages.limit: Hotel rooms are not the Sun Park's 262 registered fincas; management is not the same as ownership.
stages.missing: Hotel-by-hotel management, ownership and revenue schedule.

positions.speaker: CAM — creditor and litigant
positions.point: CAM's court response defended the ACTÚA valuation method against GESVALT's objections.
positions.limit: This is a party position in Concurso 36/2012, not an independent judicial finding validating every premise.

positions.speaker: RICPE — issuer/project publicity
positions.point: The marketing record used broader Sun Park ownership/project language while describing unresolved plans and conditions.
positions.limit: RICPE's statements are not automatically CAM's litigation admissions or proof of investor reliance.

positions.speaker: RICPE — company secretary's certificate
positions.point: The signed 20 July certificate recorded 54 CAM, 190 LPB and 18 third-party fincas and a conditional transaction.
positions.limit: This qualifies the project narrative but does not prove deliberate earlier misrepresentation.

valuations.title: ACTÚA — 31 titles
valuations.basis: Allocated value within the CAM-commissioned replacement-cost exercise.
valuations.limit: Not the value of the entire hotel or a court determination of all rights.

valuations.title: GESVALT — RICS
valuations.basis: Whole-tourism-unit market-value opinion with DCF assumptions.
valuations.limit: Purpose, inspected premises, assumed rights and income must be read with the report.

valuations.title: GESVALT — ECO
valuations.basis: Mortgage-purpose valuation following a 23 May inspection.
valuations.limit: Different purpose and basis from the RICS opinion.

valuations.title: 31-facility disposal
valuations.basis: Transaction price for an ancillary-title branch, not another expert appraisal.
valuations.limit: This is not the price paid for all 262 fincas and cannot be subtracted from whole-hotel values to calculate damages.

finance.name: Financing
finance.limit: Contract and bank disbursement remain to be reconciled.

finance.name: Operation
finance.limit: Platform figures are not hotel-specific net receipts.

finance.name: Recovery claim
finance.limit: A right-holder, actual harm and legal causation must be proved.
